literal.prompt: Какое из этих событий произошло в марте 1921 года?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The neutral prompt asks which of four historical events occurred in March 1921. The primary Kronstadt context directly identifies that event. Each alternative is a real event with its own official primary context, so none is made categorically absurd by a political qualifier.

literalGroups.literal: Кронштадтское восстание моряков против большевистской власти произошло в марте 1921 года. Вскоре восстание было подавлено.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained primary page states that the Kronstadt uprising began in March 1921 and was soon suppressed. The explanation follows those exact claims.

literalGroups.literal: Кровавое воскресенье — расстрел шествия рабочих в Санкт-Петербурге 9 января 1905 года.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained Presidential Library context documents the workers procession and 9 (22) January 1905 firing, grounding the Bloody Sunday date and event.

literalGroups.literal: Восстание декабристов произошло в Санкт-Петербурге в декабре 1825 года.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained Presidential Library context dates the Decembrist armed uprising to 14 (26) December 1825 in St Petersburg.

literalGroups.literal: Февральская революция 1917 года привела к падению монархии в России.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained Presidential Library context links the February Revolution to the overthrow of autocracy in 1917, grounding the monarchy-fall fact.

literalGroups.literal: В марте 1921 года против большевиков восстали гарнизон Кронштадта и экипажи некоторых кораблей Балтийского флота.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained Presidential Library context names the Kronstadt garrison and crews of some Baltic Fleet ships and dates their uprising against the Bolsheviks to March 1921.
